modules.name: Mobile App UI/UX
modules.description: The mobile app interface rules covering home screens, menus, buttons, forms, notifications, loading, empty and error states, and animations.

modules.name: Watchman screen
modules.description: A dedicated mobile screen for watchmen with extra-large controls and text in Gujarati and Hindi.

requirements.title: Role-based home screen
requirements.description: Each user sees only what they need on the home screen, with the most-used action at the top.

requirements.title: Notifications open exact screen
requirements.description: Tapping a notification opens the exact relevant screen, not the home screen.

requirements.title: Auto-fill known details in forms
requirements.description: Forms auto-fill known details such as flat and name.

requirements.title: Camera button for photos in forms
requirements.description: Forms provide a camera button for adding photos.

requirements.title: Placeholder blocks while loading
requirements.description: Loading states use placeholder blocks instead of blank screens or spinners.

requirements.title: Empty screens with message and one action
requirements.description: Empty screens show a simple message and one action, for example "No complaints. Raise one".

requirements.title: Plain-language error messages
requirements.description: Errors use plain words that say what to do next and never show technical messages.

requirements.title: Watchman screen with large controls
requirements.description: The watchman screen has extra-large buttons and text, is in Gujarati and Hindi, and is usable with one hand.

rules.title: Bottom menu limit
rules.description: The bottom menu has at most 4–5 items per role.

rules.title: One main button per screen
rules.description: Each screen has one main button, which must be clearly visible.

rules.title: Minimum touch target size
rules.description: Touch targets must be at least 48 × 48 px for easy thumb use.

rules.title: Required fields only in forms
rules.description: Forms ask for required fields only.

rules.title: Animation duration limit
rules.description: Animations are short and subtle, lasting only 150–250 ms.
